title: Sorsogon - Wikipedia
text: Sorsogon, officially the Province of Sorsogon, is a province in the Philippines located in the Bicol Region.The Sorsogon Ayta people live only on the municipality of Prieto Diaz, Sorsogon. They are one of the original Negrito settlers in the entire Philippines.

title: Ayta, Sorsogon Language (AYS)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Sorsogon Ayta is an endangered indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by the elderly only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
